CIV.note: No rule or authority on AI harms is stated.
AI adoption is a strategy pillar only; no government AI system stated.
AI infrastructure is named only as an investor opportunity; no builder, funder or site.
Nothing on civil servant digital-skills training.
Coverage extension is a stated aim; no rural programme launched or counted.
Digital skills is a strategy pillar and an aim to train people; no programme launched or counted.

facts.fact: Minister Djibril Ouattara presented to investors on 9 July 2026 the broad lines of the national digital development strategy within the 2026-2030 national development plan, built on seven pillars.
